basic.title: Senior Fullstack AI Engineer
basic.summary: Hands-on AI fullstack engineer who builds AI products that actually ship. Six-plus years turning messy data, product ideas, and business needs into production-ready AI systems for US/EU enterprises and early-stage startups, across backend services, APIs, data pipelines, LLM and agent workflows, model deployment, and production reliability, with a focus on regulated domains like healthcare and finance.

experience.title: Senior AI Fullstack Engineer / Azure Fabric Engineer
bullets: Built a production-grade GenAI assistant PoC for BaptistCare (Australian aged care): a RAG system over clinical and policy documents on Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Search, with a FastAPI backend and a streaming React/Next.js UI.

Designed the document-intelligence pipeline (Azure Document Intelligence, semantic chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval) and an evaluation framework measuring retrieval recall, answer faithfulness, and latency.

Led the Whiddon data platform: an Azure Synapse medallion warehouse, Azure Data Factory ingestion across 5-7 source systems, master data management, and Power BI executive reporting with row-level security.
Built predictive analytics for resident deterioration risk and funding/staffing forecasts, and set the architecture for event-driven real-time integration via Azure Service Bus.

experience.title: Senior AI Fullstack Engineer
bullets: Led production ML/AI systems for a Fortune 500 US financial-services client, improving fraud detection accuracy by +18%.
Built and deployed LLM applications (chat assistants, document QA) using fine-tuned models and RAG pipelines, plus agent-based workflows for enterprise automation.
Fine-tuned LLMs on domain data and built prompt-engineering frameworks to improve accuracy and reduce hallucinations and cost.

As primary ML/AI lead for a healthcare startup, built core AI features 0->1 (clinical/document assistants, recommendation systems, CV medical-document pipelines), cutting model latency ~30% and scaling to tens of thousands of users.
Delivered AI across fintech, e-commerce, and logistics: NLP systems, RAG and fine-tuning pipelines, and computer-vision automation, from pilot to production.
